verdict.rationale: A probe shows no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at docs.poly.app/llms.txt), but the docs are served as raw Markdown pages (docs.poly.app/raw/*.md) that an agent could be pointed at. Poly also ships agent-oriented guidance: a `poly-cli` agent skill that teaches an agent to compose `poly` commands, and a Claude Code plugin that "teaches Claude how to use Poly." Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, explicit documentation that the raw Markdown docs are meant for agent consumption, and independent corroboration of agents successfully using the docs.
